note: The 2026 Ramona Farm Stand Christmas Crawl lineup, from the Mini Barn Market announcement. placeholder is false. showStands false hides the stand list and the tour on the public page. Set showStands true on launch day and the list comes back. The home-screen app start_url is the private preview in crawl2026/manifest.webmanifest; change it to /crawl2026 on that same day. firstStop is the stand that stays first on the list and is stop 1 of the suggested drive. The rest of that drive is ordered from firstStop, not from the visitor's phone. Match it by name, slug, id, or Instagram handle — mini-barn-market is Mini Barn Market. hideHours lists stands whose hours stay off this page (the main map still shows them). To add a stand, append an object to participants. name is what visitors see. match is the stand's name in the farmstand feed when the announcement uses a different one. instagram is the handle without @. A stand is included only when name, match, or instagram lines up with the live stands feed (or data/stands.json if that feed is down). Anything that does not match is listed on the crawl page with no address and no pin. Do not invent an address. date, time, and prizes are the real event details. There is no meeting place.
prizes: Snap a photo at every crawl stand you visit, tag the stand, and use #RamonaFarmStandCrawl. Every stand you post is one entry to win a holiday gift basket full of goodies from the crawl stands.
